import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Flame,
  Shield,
  Activity,
  ChevronRight,
  AlertTriangle,
  Clock,
  TrendingUp,
  Sliders
} from 'lucide-react';
import { saasApi } from '../services/saas';


export const VulnerabilityMgmtCenter: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'overview' | 'vulnerabilities' | 'asset_exposures' | 'virtual_patches' | 'campaigns' | 'epss_distribution'>('overview');
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<any>(null);
  const [vulnerabilities, setVulnerabilities] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [assetExposures, setAssetExposures] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [virtualPatches, setVirtualPatches] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [campaigns, setCampaigns] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [epssBuckets, setEpssBuckets] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Deploy virtual patch modal state
  const [showPatchModal, setShowPatchModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [targetCve, setTargetCve] = useState<string>('CVE-2024-3400');
  const [patchRuleType, setPatchRuleType] = useState<string>('AWS_WAF');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRBVMData();
  }, []);

  const fetchRBVMData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const [sum, vulns, assets, vps, camps, epss] = await Promise.all([
        saasApi.getRBVMSummary(),
        saasApi.getVulnerabilities(),
        saasApi.getAssetExposures(),
        saasApi.getVirtualPatches(),
        saasApi.getRemediationCampaigns(),
        saasApi.getEPSSDistribution()
      ]);
      setSummary(sum);
      setVulnerabilities(vulns);
      setAssetExposures(assets);
      setVirtualPatches(vps);
      setCampaigns(camps);
      setEpssBuckets(epss);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to load RBVM data:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeployPatch = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      await saasApi.deployVirtualPatch({
        cve_id: targetCve,
        rule_type: patchRuleType
      });
      setShowPatchModal(false);
      fetchRBVMData();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to deploy virtual patch:', err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Flame className="h-7 w-7 text-rose-500" />
            Adaptive Risk-Based Vulnerability Management (RBVM) & EPSS 2.0
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
            Exploit Prediction Scoring System 2.0, CISA KEV Catalog, Asset Tier Prioritization & WAF/IPS Virtual Patching.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowPatchModal(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition-colors"
          >
            <Shield className="h-4 w-4" /> Deploy Virtual Patch
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Top Metrics Ribbon */}
      {summary && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-3.5">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">RBVM Posture</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-400 mt-1">{summary.overall_rbvm_posture_score}<span className="text-xs text-slate-500">/100</span></div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">Exploit-Hardened</div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-3.5">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Tracked CVEs</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-400 mt-1">{summary.total_tracked_cves_count}</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">EPSS Mapped</div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-3.5">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">P0 Criticals</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-rose-400 mt-1">{summary.critical_p0_cves_count}</div>

          </div>

            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-400 mt-1">{summary.cisa_kev_active_exposures}</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 mt-0.5">Known Exploited</div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-3.5">
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Virtual Patches</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400 mt-1">{summary.active_virtual_patches_count}</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-cyan-400 mt-0.5">WAF/IPS Enforcing</div>
          </div>

            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">SLA Compliance</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-400 mt-1">{summary.sla_compliance_rate_pct}%</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">On-Track Remediations</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-slate-800 gap-1 overflow-x-auto">
        {[
          { id: 'overview', label: 'RBVM Overview', icon: Flame },
          { id: 'vulnerabilities', label: 'Prioritized CVE Matrix', icon: AlertTriangle },
          { id: 'asset_exposures', label: 'Asset Exposures & SLAs', icon: Clock },
          { id: 'virtual_patches', label: 'Virtual Patching (WAF/IPS)', icon: Shield },
          { id: 'campaigns', label: 'Remediation Campaigns', icon: TrendingUp },
          { id: 'epss_distribution', label: 'EPSS 2.0 Distribution', icon: Sliders }
        ].map(tab => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id as any)}
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${
                activeTab === tab.id
                  ? 'border-rose-500 text-rose-300'
                  : 'border-transparent text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <Icon className="h-4 w-4" />{tab.label}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <div className="h-64 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400">
          <Activity className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-rose-400 mr-3" />
          Loading Adaptive Risk-Based Vulnerability Management Engine...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* TAB 1: Overview */}
          {activeTab === 'overview' && summary && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {/* Prioritized Actionable CVEs */}
              <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400" /> Critical Zero-Day & Actively Exploited Threats
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {vulnerabilities.filter(v => v.priority_level === 'P0_CRITICAL').map((v) => (
                    <div key={v.id} className="p-3.5 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-bold">
                        <span className="text-rose-400 text-sm">{v.cve_id}</span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 text-[10px]">{v.priority_level}</span>
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 text-[10px]">EPSS: {(v.epss_probability * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-slate-200 font-semibold">{v.title}</div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{v.description}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex justify-between pt-1 border-t border-slate-800/60">
                        <span>Component: {v.affected_component} · CVSS: {v.cvss_v3_score}</span>
                        <span>Threat Actors: {v.associated_threat_actors.join(', ')}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/60">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 mb-2">Priority Remediation Directives:</div>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    {summary.top_remediation_priorities.map((pri: string, idx: number) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="text-xs text-slate-400 flex items-start gap-2">
                        <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        {pri}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Active Campaigns */}
              <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" /> Remediation Sprints
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {campaigns.map((camp) => (
                    <div key={camp.id} className="p-3 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-lg border border-slate-800/60 text-xs space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-bold text-slate-200">
                        <span>{camp.campaign_name}</span>
                        <span className="text-emerald-400 text-[10px]">{camp.completion_percentage}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden">
                        <div className="bg-emerald-500 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${camp.completion_percentage}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex justify-between">
                        <span>Remediated: {camp.remediated_assets_count}/{camp.total_targeted_assets}</span>
                        <span>{camp.owner_team}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: Prioritized CVE Matrix */}
          {activeTab === 'vulnerabilities' && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400" /> Prioritized Vulnerabilities Ledger
                </h3>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Ranked by RBVM Composite Risk Index</span>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {vulnerabilities.map((v) => (
                  <div key={v.id} className="p-4 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs space-y-2.5">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-bold">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-base text-rose-400">{v.cve_id}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal">({v.affected_component})</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 text-[10px]">
                          RBVM: {v.rbvm_composite_score}/100 ({v.priority_level})
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-slate-200 font-semibold">{v.title}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{v.description}</div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800/60 text-[10px]">
                      <div><strong>CVSS v3.1:</strong> <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">{v.cvss_v3_score}</span></div>
                      <div><strong>EPSS Probability:</strong> <span className="text-rose-400 font-bold">{(v.epss_probability * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span> ({v.epss_percentile}th pct)</div>
                      <div><strong>CISA KEV:</strong> <span className={v.in_cisa_kev ? "text-rose-400 font-bold" : "text-slate-400"}>{v.in_cisa_kev ? "YES (Active Exploit)" : "No"}</span></div>
                      <div><strong>Ransomware:</strong> <span className={v.ransomware_associated ? "text-rose-400 font-bold" : "text-slate-400"}>{v.ransomware_associated ? "Associated" : "None"}</span></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 3: Asset Exposures & SLAs */}
          {activeTab === 'asset_exposures' && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" /> Asset Vulnerability Instances & Remediation SLA Deadlines
              </h3>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                  <thead className="bg-slate-950 text-slate-400 uppercase text-[10px]">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-3">Asset Hostname & IP</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Criticality Tier</th>
                      <th className="p-3">CVE Exposure</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Port / Service</th>
                      <th className="p-3">SLA Due Date</th>
                      <th className="p-3">SLA Compliance</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Remediation Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/50 text-slate-200">
                    {assetExposures.map((asset) => (
                      <tr key={asset.id} className="hover:bg-slate-950/40">
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <div className="font-bold text-indigo-300">{asset.hostname}</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">{asset.ip_address}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-[10px] font-semibold">{asset.asset_criticality}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-3 font-mono text-rose-400 font-bold">{asset.cve_id}</td>

                            {asset.is_sla_breached ? 'BREACHED' : 'IN_SLA'}

          )}

          {/* TAB 4: Virtual Patching */}
          {activeTab === 'virtual_patches' && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Shield className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400" /> WAF & IPS Virtual Patching Compensating Controls
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowPatchModal(true)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold"
                >
                  + Deploy Virtual Patch
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {virtualPatches.map((vp) => (
                  <div key={vp.id} className="p-4 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-bold">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-rose-400">{vp.cve_id}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-300">· {vp.rule_name}</span>
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 text-[10px]">{vp.rule_type}</span>
                      </div>
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 text-[10px]">
                        {vp.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-900 rounded font-mono text-[11px] text-cyan-300 overflow-x-auto">
                      {vp.rule_syntax}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[10px] text-slate-400 pt-1">
                      <span>Total Exploit Attempts Blocked: <strong className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">{vp.total_blocked_requests_count.toLocaleString()}</strong></span>
                      <span>Deployed: {new Date(vp.deployed_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 5: Remediation Campaigns */}
          {activeTab === 'campaigns' && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-400" /> Vulnerability Remediation Campaigns & Burn-Down
              </h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                {campaigns.map((camp) => (
                  <div key={camp.id} className="p-4 bg-slate-950/60 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-bold text-slate-200">
                      <span className="text-sm text-indigo-300">{camp.campaign_name}</span>
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 text-[10px]">
                        {camp.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-slate-400">Owner Team: <strong>{camp.owner_team}</strong></div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 font-mono">Target CVEs: {camp.target_cves.join(', ')}</div>

                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        <span>Burn-Down Progress</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-emerald-400">{camp.completion_percentage}% ({camp.remediated_assets_count}/{camp.total_targeted_assets} Assets)</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                        <div className="bg-emerald-500 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${camp.completion_percentage}%` }}></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 pt-1 border-t border-slate-800/60">
                      Target Due Date: {new Date(camp.target_completion_date).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 6: EPSS Distribution */}
          {activeTab === 'epss_distribution' && (
            <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-4">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sliders className="h-4 w-4 text-rose-400" /> EPSS 2.0 Global Exploit Probability Distribution
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                EPSS (Exploit Prediction Scoring System) projects the empirical likelihood that a software vulnerability will be exploited in the wild within 30 days. Only <strong>~2.0%</strong> of all CVEs exceed 0.70 probability.
              </p>

              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
                {epssBuckets.map((b, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="p-3.5 bg-slate-950/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-xs space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-bold">
                      <span className="text-slate-200">{b.bucket}</span>
                      <span className="text-rose-400 font-bold">{b.cve_count.toLocaleString()} CVEs ({b.percentage}%)</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-full bg-slate-800 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div className="bg-rose-500 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${b.percentage}%` }}></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {/* Deploy Virtual Patch Modal */}
      {showPatchModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-100">Deploy Virtual Patch Compensating Control</h3>
            <form onSubmit={handleDeployPatch} className="space-y-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Target CVE ID</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={targetCve}
                  onChange={(e) => setTargetCve(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-slate-200"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-400 mb-1">Virtual Patch Engine</label>
                <select
                  value={patchRuleType}
                  onChange={(e) => setPatchRuleType(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-slate-200"
                >
                  <option value="AWS_WAF">AWS WAF Rule Statement (JSON)</option>
                  <option value="MODSECURITY">ModSecurity / Coraza OWASP CRS</option>
                  <option value="SURICATA_IPS">Suricata / Snort IPS Signature</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPatchModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-semibold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white rounded-xl font-semibold"
                >
                  Deploy Compensating Rule
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

/**
 * frontend/src/services/adaptiveMl.ts
 * ===================================
 * Phase 3.10 Adaptive ML Detection Intelligence & Model Governance API Client.
 */

import api from './api';

export interface AdaptiveDetectionScoreBreakdown {
  ml_score: number;
  rule_score: number;
  behavior_score: number;
  ioc_score: number;
  graph_score: number;
}

export interface AdaptiveDetectionResult {
  detection_id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  is_malicious: boolean;
  attack_type: string;
  severity: string;
  risk_score: number;
  final_confidence: number;
  latency_ms: number;
  scores: AdaptiveDetectionScoreBreakdown;
  weights_applied: {
    ml: number;
    rules: number;
    behavior: number;
    ioc: number;
    graph: number;
  };
  safety_guardrails: {
    requires_human_approval: boolean;
    is_opaque_ml_only: boolean;
    deterministic_rule_matched: boolean;
    ioc_matched: boolean;
    policy_mode: string;
  };
  telemetry_breakdown: {
    ml_ensemble: {
      ml_score: number;
      ensemble_prediction: string;
      ensemble_confidence: number;
      model_agreement_pct: number;
      individual_models: Record<string, { predicted_class: string; confidence: number; is_malicious: boolean }>;
      strategy: string;
    };
    deterministic_rules: {
      rule_score: number;
      matched_count: number;
      matches: Array<{ rule_id: string; rule_name: string; severity: string; attack_type: string; mitre_technique?: string }>;
      authoritative_rule?: string;
    };
    behavioral_baseline: {
      behavior_score: number;
      is_anomalous: boolean;
      anomalous_metrics: string[];
      max_z_score: number;
      explanation: string;
    };
    threat_intel: {
      ioc_score: number;
      has_ioc_match: boolean;
      matched_count: number;
      matched_iocs: Array<{ value: string; type: string; feed: string; severity: string; threat_type: string }>;
    };
    attack_graph: {
      graph_score: number;
      is_lateral_movement: boolean;
      hop_count: number;
      is_crown_jewel: boolean;
      factors: string[];
    };
  };
}

export interface DriftStatusSummary {
  reference_version: string;
  baseline_hash: string | null;
  accumulated_samples: number;
  min_window_size: number;
  ready_for_evaluation: boolean;
  window_counter: number;
  thresholds: {
    psi_threshold: number;
    ks_alpha: number;
  };
}

export interface DriftEvaluationResult {
  window_id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  sample_count: number;
  status: string; // NORMAL, WARNING, DRIFT_DETECTED

FILE: frontend/src/services/api.ts
================================================================================
import axios from 'axios';
import { authStorage } from '../utils/authStorage';

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: '/api/v1',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
});

// Request Interceptor to attach JWT Bearer Token, X-Tenant-ID & Request Correlation ID
api.interceptors.request.use(
  (config) => {
    const token = authStorage.getAccessToken();
    const activeTenantId = authStorage.getActiveTenantId();
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    if (activeTenantId && !config.headers['X-Tenant-ID']) {
      config.headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = activeTenantId;
    }
    // Generate correlation X-Request-ID for client requests
    if (!config.headers['X-Request-ID']) {
      config.headers['X-Request-ID'] = `client-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`;
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error)
);

// Response Interceptor for handling 401 Unauthorized globally
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  (error) => {
    if (error.response && error.response.status === 401) {
      authStorage.clearAccessToken();
      if (window.location.pathname !== '/login') {
        window.location.href = '/login';
      }
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);


export default api;

export const authService = {
  login: async (username: string, password: string): Promise<TokenResponse> => {
    const formData = new URLSearchParams();
    formData.append('username', username);
    formData.append('password', password);

    const response = await api.post<TokenResponse>('/auth/login', formData, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
      },
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  register: async (data: { username: string; email: string; password: string; full_name: string; role: string }): Promise<User> => {
    const response = await api.post<User>('/auth/register', data);
    return response.data;
  },

  getMe: async (): Promise<User> => {
    const response = await api.get<User>('/auth/me');
    return response.data;
  },
};

        'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',
      },
    });
    return response.data;
  },

    const response = await api.post('/predict/remediate', {
      target_ip: targetIp,
      action: action,
    });
    return response.data;
  },
};

FILE: frontend/src/services/reports.ts
================================================================================
import api from './api';
import { ReportResponse } from '../types';
import { authStorage } from '../utils/authStorage';

export const reportService = {
  generateReport: async (format: 'pdf' | 'excel' | 'csv'): Promise<ReportResponse> => {
    const response = await api.post<ReportResponse>('/reports/generate', {
      format,
      include_shap_charts: true,
    });
    return response.data;
  },

  downloadFile: async (downloadUrl: string): Promise<void> => {
    // Use fetch here so the auth header is explicit and binary responses are never
    // coerced by Axios into a JSON error payload.
    const token = authStorage.getAccessToken();
    const response = await fetch(downloadUrl, {
      headers: token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : undefined,
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      let detail = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
      try {
        const body = await response.json();
        detail = body.detail || detail;
      } catch {
        // Keep the HTTP status when the server response is not JSON.
      }
      throw new Error(detail);
    }

    const blob = await response.blob();
    const contentDisposition = response.headers.get('content-disposition') || '';
    const filenameMatch = contentDisposition.match(/filename="?([^";]+)"?/i);
    const fallbackName = decodeURIComponent(downloadUrl.split('/').pop() || 'aegivanta-report');
    const filename = filenameMatch?.[1] || fallbackName;
    const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = objectUrl;
    link.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  },
};

/**
 * frontend/src/services/responseService.ts
 * API Service for Controlled SOAR Approvals & Dry-Run Executions.
 */

import api from './api';

export interface ResponseApprovalItem {
  id: string;
  incident_id: string;
  requested_action: string;
  target_entity: string;
  parameters?: any;
  requested_by: string;
  requested_at: string;
  approved_by?: string;
  approved_at?: string;
  rejected_by?: string;
  rejected_at?: string;
  status: string;
  reason?: string;
  is_dry_run: boolean;
  execution_id?: string;
  audit_id?: string;
}

export const responseService = {
  listRequests: async (statusFilter?: string): Promise<ResponseApprovalItem[]> => {
    const url = statusFilter ? `/response/requests?status_filter=${statusFilter}` : '/response/requests';
    const res = await api.get(url);
    return Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : (res.data?.items || []);
  },

  submitRequest: async (incidentId: string, requestedAction: string, targetEntity: string, parameters?: any): Promise<any> => {
    const res = await api.post('/response/request', {
      incident_id: incidentId,
      requested_action: requestedAction,
      target_entity: targetEntity,
      parameters
    });
    return res.data;
  },

  approveRequest: async (requestId: string, forceLive: boolean = false): Promise<any> => {
    const res = await api.post(`/response/approve/${requestId}?force_live=${forceLive}`);
    return res.data;
  },

  rejectRequest: async (requestId: string, reason: string): Promise<any> => {
    const res = await api.post(`/response/reject/${requestId}`, { reason });
    return res.data;
  },

  executeDryRun: async (incidentId: string, actionType: string, targetEntity: string, parameters?: any): Promise<any> => {
    const res = await api.post('/response/execute-dryrun', {
      incident_id: incidentId,
      action_type: actionType,
      target_entity: targetEntity,
      parameters
    });
    return res.data;
  }
};

import axios from 'axios';

const API_BASE = '/api/v1';

const getAuthHeaders = () => {
  const token = authStorage.getAccessToken();
  const activeTenantId = authStorage.getActiveTenantId();
  return {
    headers: {
      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
      ...(activeTenantId ? { 'X-Tenant-ID': activeTenantId } : {})
    }
  };
};

/**

 */

import api from './api';

export interface SOCOverviewData {
  time_window_days: number;
  sample_incidents_count: number;
  sample_alerts_count: number;
  mttd_minutes: number | null;
  mttd_status?: string;
  mttr_minutes: number | null;
  mttr_status?: string;
  open_incidents: number;
  resolved_incidents: number;
  alert_to_incident_ratio: number;
  estimated_false_positive_rate_pct: number | null;
  false_positive_status?: string;
  generated_at: string;
}

export interface AttackCoverageData {
  id: string;
  observed_techniques_count: number;
  detected_techniques_count: number;
  total_matrix_techniques: number;
  coverage_percentage: number;
  tactic_breakdown: Record<string, {
    total_techniques: number;
    detected_count: number;
    coverage_pct: number;
    is_active_observation: boolean;
  }>;
  technique_details: {
    detected_techniques: string[];
    catalog: Record<string, string[]>;
  };
  created_at: string;
}

export const socMetricsService = {
  getOverview: async (lookbackDays: number = 30): Promise<SOCOverviewData> => {
    const res = await api.get(`/soc-metrics/overview?lookback_days=${lookbackDays}`);
    return res.data;
  },

  getWorkload: async (): Promise<any> => {
    const res = await api.get('/soc-metrics/workload');
    return res.data;
  },

  getAttackCoverage: async (): Promise<AttackCoverageData> => {
    const res = await api.get('/attack-coverage');
    return res.data;
  },

  recomputeCoverage: async (): Promise<any> => {
    const res = await api.post('/attack-coverage/snapshot');
    return res.data;
  }
};

/**
 * frontend/src/services/threatGraphService.ts
 * API Service for Threat Intelligence Graph Topology and Evidence Inspection.
 */

import api from './api';

export interface ThreatGraphNodeItem {
  id: string;
  node_type: string;
  label: string;
  reference_id?: string;
  criticality?: string;
  ip_address?: string;
  attack_type?: string;
  severity?: string;
  risk_score?: number;
  threat_type?: string;
  stage?: string;
}

export interface ThreatGraphEdgeItem {
  id: string;
  source: string;
  target: string;
  relationship_type: string;
  confidence: number;
  evidence_count: number;
}

export interface ThreatGraphData {
  total_nodes: number;
  total_edges: number;
  nodes: ThreatGraphNodeItem[];
  edges: ThreatGraphEdgeItem[];
  generated_at: string;
}

export const threatGraphService = {
  getGraphTopology: async (limit: number = 150): Promise<ThreatGraphData> => {
    const res = await api.get(`/threat-graph?limit=${limit}`);
    return res.data;
  },

  getNodeEvidence: async (nodeId: string): Promise<any> => {
    const res = await api.get(`/threat-graph/nodes/${nodeId}/evidence`);
    return res.data;
  }
};

  incident_id: string;
  timestamp: string;
  event_type: 'DETECTION' | 'ALERT_CORRELATED' | 'TRIAGE' | 'STATUS_CHANGE' | 'ANALYST_ACTION' | 'REMEDIATION' | 'RESOLUTION';
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actor: string;
  metadata_payload?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface IncidentDetail extends IncidentItem {
  asset?: ProtectedAsset;
  alerts: AlertItem[];
  timeline: TimelineEvent[];
}

export interface ModelPerformanceItem {
  id?: string;
  model_name: string;
  model_type: string;
  accuracy: number | null;
  f1_score: number | null;
  precision_score: number | null;
  recall_score: number | null;
  roc_auc: number | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  trained_at?: string;
}

export interface AnalyticsSummary {
  network_status?: string;
  total_packets_inspected: number;
  total_threats_detected?: number;
  total_threats_isolated?: number;
  critical_incidents_count?: number;
  critical_threats_count?: number;
  prediction_accuracy?: number;
  active_model?: string;
  attack_distribution: AttackDistributionItem[];
  top_source_ips?: Array<{ ip: string; count: number }>;
  top_malicious_ips?: Array<{ ip: string; count: number }>;
  model_performance?: ModelPerformanceItem[];
  model_leaderboard?: ModelPerformanceItem[];
  recent_incidents?: IncidentItem[];
}

export interface AttackDistributionItem {
  attack_type: string;
  count: number;
  percentage?: number;
}

export interface ReportResponse {
  download_url: string;
  format: string;
  generated_at: string;
}

FILE: frontend/src/utils/authStorage.ts

/**
 * frontend/src/utils/authStorage.ts
 * =================================
 * Canonical token and tenant storage management for Aegivanta Frontend.
 * Unifies access across standard REST API, SaaS services, WebSockets, and Reports.
 */

const TOKEN_KEY_PRIMARY = 'aegivanta_token';
const TOKEN_KEY_LEGACY = 'sentinel_token';
const TOKEN_KEY_GENERIC = 'token';
const TENANT_KEY = 'active_tenant_id';

export const authStorage = {
  /**
   * Retrieves active access token with fallback across supported keys.
   */
  getAccessToken(): string | null {
    return (
      localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY_PRIMARY) ||
      localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY_LEGACY) ||
      localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY_GENERIC) ||
      null
    );
  },

  /**
   * Persists access token across standard keys for backward compatibility.
   */
  setAccessToken(token: string): void {
    localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY_PRIMARY, token);
    localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY_LEGACY, token);
    localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY_GENERIC, token);
  },

  /**
   * Clears all stored authentication tokens.
   */
  clearAccessToken(): void {
    localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY_PRIMARY);
    localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY_LEGACY);
    localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY_GENERIC);
  },

  /**
   * Retrieves active tenant ID.
   */
  getActiveTenantId(): string | null {
    return localStorage.getItem(TENANT_KEY) || null;
  },

  /**
   * Sets active tenant ID.
   */
  setActiveTenantId(tenantId: string): void {
    localStorage.setItem(TENANT_KEY, tenantId);
  },

  /**
   * Clears active tenant ID.
   */
  clearActiveTenantId(): void {
    localStorage.removeItem(TENANT_KEY);
  }
};
